summary: First-run frontend test of RF Photos (Expo web preview, 390x844). Core flows work well: import via file picker (3 JPEGs → 3 tiles), home grid, filter chips (all/photos/videos/favourites/screenshots/recent), library count, multi-select bar (fav + archive both work and archive removes tiles from home), Albums tab with all 7 smart cards (smart-favourites/videos/screenshots/duplicates/archive/imported/vault), New smart album prompt (dialog-input + dialog-confirm-button), Search (/search) with result count '2 media · 0 documents' + search-why rendered, Create tab with hero collage + tool editor present, Library tab, Vault setup PIN screen renders and accepts digits, Agent command input visible, Automation screen loads with pick/dry-run/nl-input, Settings theme switching (light↔dark works visually), and 15/16 other screens render without crashing. Backup create button present. TWO CRITICAL CRASHES: /clipboard route and /inspector (viewer-info-button) both throw 'Maximum update depth exceeded' + 'getSnapshot should be cached' and are caught by ErrorBoundary showing 'Something went wrong'. Root cause: useStore selectors return new array references on every call (via spread/filter/sort) which breaks React's useSyncExternalStore memoisation.

ui_bugs.issue: Opens then immediately crashes with 'Maximum update depth exceeded' (ErrorBoundary → Something went wrong). Reproduce: tap any media-tile-0 → viewer-info-button. React warns 'The result of getSnapshot should be cached to avoid an infinite loop'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/inspector.tsx:18-19 — `useStore((s) => s.versions.filter(...))` and `useStore((s) => s.events.filter(...))` return a new array every subscription check.

/clipboard route crashes on open with the same 'Maximum update depth exceeded' infinite loop. Reference: /app/frontend/app/clipboard.tsx:14 — `useStore((s) => [...s.clipboard].sort(...))` returns a new array every call. Fix: compute sorted list via useMemo over the stable selector `useStore((s) => s.clipboard)`, or wrap with zustand's useShallow.

issues: Chevron-back button is used as viewer-close-button (no X icon) — matches spec but could confuse testers expecting an X. Not a bug.

action_items: FIX inspector.tsx:18-19 — wrap derived arrays with useMemo over stable `s.versions`/`s.events` selectors, or use zustand's useShallow / createSelector, so getSnapshot returns a stable reference. This unblocks viewer-info-button → inspector-hash-button flow.
FIX clipboard.tsx:14 — same pattern. Select raw `s.clipboard` then sort inside useMemo. This unblocks the /clipboard screen.
After both fixes, re-run inspector + clipboard flows to confirm no infinite loops and that inspector-hash-button computes a SHA-256 for data: URIs.
critical_code_review_comments: Three store selectors return non-memoised derived arrays (clipboard.tsx:14, inspector.tsx:18, inspector.tsx:19). Pattern must be audited project-wide. These are the only three found by `grep -rn 'useStore((s) =>' | grep -E '(filter|map|sort|slice|...s)'`, so scope is limited.
Expo warning at startup: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' — cosmetic but worth cleaning up when touching style sheets.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview URL: https://run-mobile-6.preview.emergentagent.com. To import media on web, click [data-testid="empty-library-state-action"] (first time) or [data-testid="home-import-button"] and use page.expect_file_chooser + set_files with pre-generated JPEG/PNG files (PIL). Picker tiles reuse the same testID as home grid: `media-tile-{index}` (NOT `picker-tile-{index}` as the review request suggested). Vault PIN entry needs small waits (~120ms) between pin-key taps; the second-pass PIN screen is the same keypad reused — don't call PINs too fast. All /clipboard and inspector flows will crash until the two selector bugs are fixed.
rca_of_issue: Root cause (both crashes): zustand store subscriptions via useSyncExternalStore require the selector to return a referentially stable value. clipboard.tsx and inspector.tsx use `.filter()` / `.sort()` / spread (`[...s.clipboard]`) inside the selector, so every subscription check returns a brand-new array → React treats it as changed → re-render → new array again → infinite loop. React 18 explicitly warns: 'The result of getSnapshot should be cached to avoid an infinite loop'. Mitigation: either (a) select the raw underlying array (`useStore(s => s.clipboard)`) and derive with useMemo in the component, or (b) wrap with zustand's `useShallow` so array identity is compared element-wise. Reproduction: open the web preview, import any photo, tap the tile → tap the info (ⓘ) icon → ErrorBoundary 'Something went wrong' appears. Same error for direct nav to /clipboard.
